question.wording: Did the taxpayer use this property as a home in 2025 (personal use of more than the greater of 14 days or 10% of the days rented at fair rental value) AND rent it out for fewer than 15 days?

options.label: Yes — used as a home and rented under 15 days: nothing reported on Schedule E

default.because: A rental is rented 15 days or more unless a preparer says otherwise

citation.wording: If you did use the unit as a home and rented the unit out for fewer than 15 days in 2025, do not report the rental income and do not deduct any rental expenses.
